entries.35d093d9c92c23de: It undertakes building construction and civil engineering work from clients, and records the portion constructed and delivered as net sales of completed construction contracts. Part of the work is ordered to affiliated companies such as The Nippon Road Co., Ltd., Nippon Fabtec Co., Ltd., and Daiichi Setsubi Kogyo Co., Ltd. In addition, it has an Investment and Development Business, in which it develops real estate itself and leases or sells it, an engineering business for offshore wind power and renewable energy, and a Building Lifecycle Business responsible for the maintenance and management of buildings. In the construction industry, orders (contracts) received, which are the value of work contracted, and net sales of completed construction contracts, which are recorded as net sales in that fiscal year, are different figures: for Shimizu Corporation on a standalone basis, orders (contracts) received for the fiscal year ended March 2026 were ¥1.8981 trillion, net sales were ¥1.5895 trillion, and the balance carried forward to the next fiscal year was ¥2.6369 trillion.

entries.3a29860254a0c0e0: In August 1937, it established Shimizu Gumi Co., Ltd., and in November of the same year it merged Shimizu Gumi, the limited partnership, and opened the Nagoya Branch, the Osaka Branch (now the Kansai Branch), and the Kyushu Branch. It expanded its branches nationwide, with the Hokkaido Branch in 1939, the Hiroshima Branch in 1945, and the Sendai Branch (now the Tohoku Branch), the Hokuriku Branch, and the Shikoku Branch in 1946.
entries.3a56c769c79d35ad: It is still listed on the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the Premier Market of the Nagoya Stock Exchange.
entries.3a8891ee75e44b03: This is a collection of businesses not included in reportable segments, comprising the engineering, green energy development and building lifecycle businesses conducted by SHIMIZU CORPORATION itself, and various businesses conducted by subsidiaries other than Nippon Road Co., Ltd. The engineering business handles renewable energy, production facilities for advanced and strategic products, and environmental remediation, and the company says it is focusing on EPC work for offshore wind power facilities and the operation of SEP vessels. The green energy development business is advancing power source development and electricity retail for renewable energy, as well as the development and implementation of the hydrogen utilization technology “Hydro Q-BiC.” The building lifecycle business provides building maintenance and services to extend building lifespans. Among subsidiaries, Milux Co., Ltd. sells and leases construction materials and equipment, SC Machinery Co., Ltd. rents out construction machinery, Shimizu Finance Co., Ltd. lends funds to group companies, and Tama Medical Campus Co., Ltd. and others conduct PFI business for public facilities.
entries.3bd42f01847c2c53: In April 1961, it offered its shares on the Tokyo over-the-counter market, listed on the Second Section of the Tokyo Stock Exchange in October of the same year, and on its First Section in February 1962. In April 2022, in line with the review of market segments, it transferred to the Prime Market of the Tokyo Stock Exchange and the Premier Market of the Nagoya Stock Exchange.
